svg.text: Original vectors + transparent PNGs. No third-party application artwork.
CIRCULAR AVATAR / 32 DIP base / transparent outside the circle
WINDOWS APPLICATION ICON / 16 & 20 px optical fits / ICO frames through 256 px
Frames larger than 96 px are reduced on this overview; supplied files keep their stated dimensions.
NEUTRAL TILE SURFACES / 48 x 48, 104 x 104, 216 x 104 DIP / radius 6 DIP
PNG scales: UI 100/125/150/175/200/300%; tiles 100/125/150/175/200%. QML should draw tile surfaces natively.
